_comment: Deterministic backstop for the idea generator. Any AI-generated topic whose text matches a pattern (case-insensitive regex) is dropped BEFORE scoring, no matter what the model produces. The self-critique premise gate in src/llm_ideas.js is the primary filter; this is the belt-and-suspenders list for premises we have already judged false/nonsensical. Add an entry whenever you catch another bad-premise pattern.

banned.reason: A personal certification is a credential of the individual who earned it; it does not transfer in a sale, so any 'transfer/gap' framing is a false premise.
A personal renewal obligation stays with the individual; it is not a transferable item between buyer and seller.
Framing a 'starter kit' as a distinct alternative to a standard onboarding package is a false dichotomy in Yourniche; they describe the same thing.
